transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Card Services. My name is Jordan. How may I help you today?
Customer: Hi Jordan, my name is Hollis Dunmore. I was looking over my card charges online and saw a line item I just don't recognize at all.
Agent: Hello, Hollis. I would be glad to help you look into that. Before we begin, could you verify your billing zip code and the phone number linked to the account?
Customer: Sure thing. The zip code is 02818, and the phone number is 401-555-0193.
Agent: Thank you for verifying that. Which transaction is giving you pause?
Customer: It says SQ *BLUE HERON PROV, and it was for $42.00. I have no idea who that is.
Agent: Let me check the details on that for you. I see a charge for $42.00 dated September 28, 2026.
Customer: September 28th... I'm trying to recall what I was doing on that date. Blue Heron doesn't sound familiar to me at all.
Agent: Looking at the processing record, it shows the card was read in person in East Greenwich around noon.
Customer: East Greenwich? Wait, September 28th was a Saturday, wasn't it?
Agent: Yes, that was on a Saturday.
Customer: Oh! You know what, my cousin and I went down to the weekend farmers' market by the water that morning.
Agent: Did you purchase anything from any of the independent sellers while you were walking around?
Customer: Yes, I bought a couple of large soy candles from a small craft booth. I remember tapping my card on a little square reader attached to the seller's phone.
Agent: The "SQ" at the beginning of the name typically indicates that kind of mobile payment setup for independent merchants.
Customer: That's totally it. The stall had a painted wooden sign with a bird on it, Blue Heron something. Forty-two dollars was the exact price for the two candle jars.
Agent: So just to sum up what we found, the $42.00 charge on September 28th matches your in-person purchase at the candle stall during the market.
Customer: That's completely right. I'm glad we looked at the town and date, because the abbreviated name on the screen had me completely confused.
